_note: AO probe rig. Not a vessel — a bench of the four occlusion cases in one plan, sized against the 1.8 m figure (one world unit is one metre, CONVENTIONS.md 3a): (1) the free-standing 1.0 x 2.4 x 1.0 post at x=12.5,z=12.5 is an OPEN corner — every one of its top corners has clear air within the AO radius, so it is the light control; (2) walls 10 and 11 meet at [3,3] in an L whose inside corner is the TIGHT INTERIOR JUNCTION, and both stand on the deck plate so the corner is a three-way (wall + wall + sole); (3) deck 2 rides on wall 12 and juts 5 m to +x, so its UNDERSIDE at y=3.0 is an overhang — dark near the wall from geometry, dark along its whole span from the sky term; (4) walls 20 and 21 are a 1.1 m BULWARK on two deck edges, whose inboard faces darken toward the sole. The doorway in wall 10 exists so the AO can be checked not to smear across a cut. Two colours only, so this still bakes to the same handful of surfaces.
